body.name: Exact robust semialgebraic variance program
body.construction: From the \(2^h\)-row table \(\mathcal A_H\), form \(F_H(w,b)=2^{-h}\sum_z[S_H(w,b;z)-2^{-h}\sum_{z'}S_H(w,b;z')]^2\). The program \(\mathfrak P_H\) minimizes \(q\) over \(m_H=\sum_a\{d_H(a)+1\}\le h^2\) support-indexed weight coordinates and \(q\), subject to the \(3h\) exposure-moment equalities and the robust constraint \(q\ge F_H(w,b)\) for every \(b\in\mathbb R^{3h}\) satisfying \(-1\le b_{a,1}+b_{a,2}z_a+b_{a,3}t_a(z)\le1\) for all \(a\) and all \(2^h\) rows \(z\). It has \(3h\) nuisance variables, \(2h2^h\) displayed linear schedule inequalities, and a variance polynomial of degree two in \(w\) and four in \(b\); quantifier elimination gives an exact finite certificate, while row enumeration gives a direct numerical program.
